comment: Copy-variant registry for tracked CTAs. build-cta-state.mjs reads api/dead-ctas.json and, when a CTA is flagged dead (shown>=N, click=0), advances its active variant index so the surface self-heals across deploys instead of waiting for a human to notice. Variant 0 is the current/default copy. {name} is interpolated client-side. See audit dead-cta-rotation-loop.

play-next.note: Cross-game play-next card headline (assets/cross-game-play-next.js). Variant 0 = the S207 completion-framed copy shipped in play-next-intent-retiming.
